control_profile: Deterministic fifty-eight-percent gross exposure with common-market residualization, robust clipping, relative-rank admission, symmetric sizing, and a close-confirmed six-percent position stop with three-bar cooldown; drawdown brakes, time stops, turnover clipping, and volatility targeting are disabled.
falsifier: Reject the stop if it fails to improve adverse symbol-week tails and temporal consistency, pushes turnover above policy, dilutes edge below fifty basis points, or destroys either sleeve under stressed costs.
formation_horizon: longs use seventy-eight completed weekly observations with a thirty-nine-week minimum; shorts use one hundred four completed weekly observations with a fifty-two-week minimum; both use Monday 00:00, 08:00, and 16:00 UTC anchors
hypothesis: The broader dual-horizon Monday ranking is profitable but a few persistent adverse symbol-weeks dominate its late-era loss; a symmetric six-percent close-confirmed position stop with three-bar cooldown should cut those tails without changing signal formation or weekly selection.
rebalance_horizon: weekly Monday 08:00 UTC direct rebalance with continuous twenty-one-bar holding between decisions
